plan.problem: Uncached SSIM repeats differ locally at 626x469; two-column component padding removed the observed discrepancy. Identify the earliest incorrect operation without changing image size or calibration.
plan.scope: Deterministic synthetic tensors: upload, HWC multiply, permuted NCHW multiply, separable blur; compare CPU mathematical results and repeat outputs. Use evidence to choose one bounded fix or retain a diagnostic if unresolved.
plan.constraints: Do not modify shared Cargo caches. Isolate experimental patches. Keep original photos/models and production engine. Run photo reconstruction after a justified implementation change; no speed or quality claim based solely on a component check.
plan.change: Limit packed contiguous-copy output vector width to a divisor of the total element count. cubecl-std only is locally patched; all other locked packages unchanged.
plan.comparison: Saved pre-fix binary versus new binary, same adapter and cache disabled in both. Three scenes, two repeats each, 12 serial short regressions. No image or camera padding.
plan.measurement: Train/evaluation/export, no state readback; no new SfM or API end-to-end measurements. New processes, OS/driver caches not flushed.
plan.acceptance: Regression must fail before and pass after; original unpadded photo probe must no longer show tail outliers. Validate full SH3, matching cameras and actual sizes on all short runs. Do not infer default-quality gains from 1000-step results.

build.cubecl_lock_overlay: Local only; all other Cargo.lock package entries unchanged.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, reference-statistics caching disabled in both variants. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
memory_scope: Logical cached reference mean/variance tensor storage only; not allocator capacity or peak process/GPU memory.

references.title: SSIM: Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity
references.use: The local SSIM path uses separable 11x11 Gaussian statistics; this round checks the tensor layout before changing the loss.

references.title: CubeCL contiguous tensor implementation
references.use: The packed contiguous copy chooses vector widths from shape and stride; the isolated fix also requires the total element count to be divisible by the selected width.

references.title: fused-ssim
references.use: Public fused kernels motivate keeping numerical layout tests separate from a Burn/Wgpu implementation change; no external kernel source copied.

references.title: Faster-GS
references.use: Recent optimization results are not claimed here; this round keeps the same 3DGS settings and tests one copy-path defect.

diagnostics.before_fix: permuted HWC→CHW read/multiply failed for width 625 and 626; width626 reported 2 mismatches in the last vectorized tail. Upload and HWC multiply were exact. Separable blur repeat was exact for the synthetic probe.
diagnostics.after_fix: Widths 624–628 all had zero mismatches; SSIM/gradient regression suite passed 6 tests. The unpadded TUM 626×469 photo probe now has zero map/gradient differences for second-moment caching and the uncached repeat.
diagnostics.fix: When selecting a packed output vector width in cubecl-std, require total element count modulo vector width == 0. This is an isolated CubeCL source patch, not a change to photo dimensions or camera calibration.
diagnostics.scope: The before/after component evidence identifies a tensor tail write defect in the locked CubeCL path. It does not prove every GPU shape is correct or that final 3DGS quality improves.

validation.component_regression_before: failed intentionally at width625 with 3 mismatches; earlier width626 probe showed two mismatches
validation.ssim_tests: 6 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored; numeric and gradient cache tests passed
validation.photo_probe_after: TUM 626x469: second-moment and uncached-repeat map/gradient differences 0; variance cache retains ~3.3e-5 expected arithmetic difference

browser.observations: All short models load. Fine pipes, cables, text and desk details remain soft; out-of-coverage views still show stretched or floating fragments and holes.

decision: Adopt only the isolated CubeCL packed-copy tail fix for the experimental Brush build; do not change the production Brush binary or enable SSIM reference caching. The fix removes the identified uninitialized tail on 624–628 widths and makes the unpadded TUM component probe repeatable, but 1000-step photo scores are exploratory and do not establish final quality or speed improvement.
training_scope: Three fixed scenes (ETH3D pipes, ETH3D office, TUM desk), 1000 steps, 1024 target long edge, 150000 budget, SH3, holdout every eighth image, fixed shared cameras; all 12 runs are exploratory short regressions. The app normally trains all photos.
